[SWS_CORE_03315] Forward-find a StringView
⌈
A member function
shall be defined for BasicString that allows forward-searching for the contents of
a StringView:
size_type find(StringView sv, size_type pos = 0) const noexcept;
This function shall behave the same as the corresponding std::basic_string func-
tion from [6, the C++17 standard].
⌋
